subject: SummitBridge inference eval slate and latency evidence
messages:
From: Lisa Cheng <lisa.cheng@summitbridge.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@summitbridge.ai>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Thanks — quick follow-up + targets

Jonas / Vanessa,

Thanks again for walking us through Redwood yesterday — that was helpful. A quick recap from our side and a couple of clarifying asks so we can move toward a pilot.

What we need:
- Primary workload: conversational summarization (chat assistant) + semantic search reranking.
- Peak concurrency: ~600 requests/sec (about 600 TPS peak, bursty during business hours).
- Latency target: p95 end-to-end (inference only) < 350ms.
- Quality: summary hallucination risk is our biggest concern — we'll want guardrails and regression monitoring.
- Compliance: SOC 2 evidence and data residency options (US).

Can you share the model shortlist you recommend, the Redwood-verified performance profiles (TPS / p50 / p95) for each model on your recommended instance types, and sample prompt sets / evals you use to detect quality regressions? Also, could you drop any benchmark traces or traces from similar pilots?

Next steps we're hoping for: model shortlist + links so our infra and procurement teams can review, then a pilot SOW.

Thanks,
Lisa Cheng
Head of AI Platforms
SummitBridge

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Cheng <lisa.cheng@summitbridge.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Thanks — quick follow-up + targets

Lisa — great to meet you and thank you for the clear targets. High-level response and attachments below. I've attached a short runbook and the raw latency traces from a comparable pilot we ran last week.

Recommended model slate (shortlist + expected Redwood-verified inference profile):
- redwood-mistral-13b-v2 (8-bit quantized): ~650 TPS (multi-request batching) on 4xA100-40GB, p50 ~28ms p95 ~220ms (inference-only token latencies for 512-token context).
- open-chat-xl-30b-fp16: ~380 TPS on 8xA100-80GB (larger context), p50 ~45ms p95 ~310ms. Good quality for summarization but higher cost.
- redwood-llama2-13b-q4f16 (quantized): ~720 TPS on 4xA100-40GB, p50 ~26ms p95 ~240ms — lower cost but watch for specific prompt failure modes on long contexts.

Notes on numbers: these are Redwood-verified profiles collected with our continuous-benchmark harness (mixed prompt set similar to SU-1 summarization + rerank queries). TPS reflects sustained steady-state with batching and prefix cache enabled; pXX are 1-hop token latencies sampled at steady-state. For end-to-end RPC we typically add ~40–60ms network overhead depending on region.

Quality guardrails / regression monitoring:
- We ship a curated prompt-set (attached link) and an eval harness that runs sampled inference continually against a gold set; we raise alerts on mean ROUGE drop > 2 points or an increase in hallucination-classification rate beyond your baseline.
- Regression signals: token-level divergence, top-k distribution shifts, and behavioral tests (consistency, hallucination, safety). We can wire these alerts to your Slack and create automatic canary rollbacks if the rolling window exceeds thresholds.

Attachments included:
- summitbridge-runbook.pdf (pilot runbook + rollout steps)
- latency-trace-20261128.jsonl (sample raw traces from a comparable e-commerce summarization pilot)

Useful links (benchmarks / prompt pack):
- Redwood benchmark run: https://app.redwood.ai/benchmarks/SB-0921/run-20261128
- Shared prompt/eval pack: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bExampleBenchmarkPack
- Redwood model catalog profiles: https://app.redwood.ai/models/redwood-mistral-13b-v2

Suggested next steps:
1) Your infra + procurement review the attached runbook and the HW profiles.
2) If acceptable, we'll issue a pilot SOW (1 month) and provision a canary pool.
3) Kickoff call to align on prompts + acceptance criteria.

Happy to jump on a short call this week to walk through the traces.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

- For procurement: who should we send the pilot SOW + pricing to at SummitBridge?

I'll draft a one-page acceptance checklist and share it to the Drive folder; Jonas / Karthik can tag the perf traces you want to highlight.
